entries.claim: On a project under Cadence the spine step now reads any file outside `.planning/` and quotes it word for word, with "never paraphrase a quote and never tidy it". Nothing keeps secret-bearing files out: not `.env*`, deploy configs, or credentials in docker-compose. So a hosting or stack decision "the code settles" can copy a live secret into spine.md.
entries.failure_scenario: Take a Cadence project with `.env.production` holding `DATABASE_URL=postgres://admin:s3cret@db.prod.example.com/app`, or a docker-compose.yml with `POSTGRES_PASSWORD: s3cret`, and a brief that never quotes hosting. Lines 912-914 treat hosting as settled by the code, and the decision has to quote the code (lines 1051-1054). The rule at 1057 forbids tidying or redacting the line. So the spine gets `> DATABASE_URL=postgres://admin:s3cret@...` with `(.env.production)` under it. That file lives in `.planning/seldon/`, which normally gets committed, and the secret later reaches architecture.md. No rule in SKILL.md, docs/FORMAT.md or the phase 6 plans excludes such files or allows redaction.
